content.short: Re7 Labs is an onchain risk curator managing vaults across Plasma, Unichain and World Chain.
content.description: Re7 Labs describes itself as investors and operators across decentralised digital-asset ecosystems, and applies in-house risk modelling to curate on-chain vaults. It runs curated vaults on Plasma, Unichain and World Chain, which makes it one of the few curators active across all three of these newer networks. A curator's job is to choose the markets, collateral and limits a vault is exposed to, so depositors are effectively trusting its risk judgement.
